name: Karneia
summary: Sparta's nine days of Apollo Karneios, the Dorian holy month that kept armies at home — atonement, Pausanias tells, for the killing of the seer Carnus on the march of the Heracleidae.
testimonia: Pausanias 3.13.3–5 (Apollo Carneus and the seer Carnus — the founding)
Thucydides 5.54 (the Karneia as the Dorian holy month)
Athenaeus 4.141e–f (the nine days and the feast of tents)
Spartan month Karneios ≈ Attic Metageitnion — the Attic mapping is a convention
